職位名稱：Marketing Manager, Incentive Strategy & Design 行銷策略及設計經理
行銷策略及設計經理
將獨立優化並執行各項員工激勵專案，以支持 Coupang 台灣物流營運之前線員工留任、參與及生產力目標。本職位需運用 Cohort Analysis、量化衡量與資料導向決策，持續辨識目標受眾、配置資源並改善方案成效。此職位亦須製作員工激勵專案執行所需的行銷相關圖像素材。
主要職責
• 設計、執行並持續優化員工激勵專案，明確鎖定目標 Cohort、激勵機制、預算、執行週期、限制條件及量化成果。
• 依到職時間、行為、留任階段、價值、參與率、回應率、出勤或生產力分析不同員工 Cohort，並制定差異化介入策略。
• 製作行銷相關圖像素材，清楚傳達員工激勵專案的方案內容、參與方式及行動訴求。
• 建立並追蹤 Conversion、Cost Efficiency、Retention、Productivity、Cost per Hour、Cost per Retention、參與率、人數及 ROI 等績效指標。
• 將資訊不完整或持續變動的商業問題轉化為結構化假設、最小可行行動、視覺溝通素材、衡量計畫及明確的迭代條件。
• 與營運、財務、分析及行銷 Stakeholder 對齊目標、處理資源取捨、確認決策權及溝通節點並推動交付。
必備資格
• 具備獨立設計、執行或優化 Promotion、Incentive、Rewards 或 Retention Program 的實務經驗。
• 具備 Cohort Analysis 經驗，並能針對不同受眾或員工群體制定差異化策略。
• 能定義、追蹤、解讀並優化量化行銷或營運績效指標。
• 能運用資料支援受眾選擇、資源配置、方案設計及行銷決策。
• 具備製作行銷相關圖像素材的實務能力，能支援 Campaign、Promotion、Incentive Program 或員工溝通需求。
• 能提供行銷圖像製作案例，並說明目標受眾、溝通目的、製作考量及實際使用情境。
• 具備跨部門專案推動及 Stakeholder Management 經驗，能處理不同目標、限制或決策權。
• 能將商業問題轉化為具體的行銷策略、方案機制、KPI、視覺溝通內容及迭代計畫。
• 能在全新、模糊且持續變動的商業環境中有效工作。
• 具備商務英文聽說能力，能與國際 Stakeholder 進行雙向工作溝通。
• 能接受並勝任高度 Hands-on 的 Individual Contributor 工作模式，直接負責分析、方案設計、行銷圖像素材製作、監測及優化。
優先資格
• 具物流、電商、科技、Marketplace、Delivery-tech、Platform Business、Fulfillment，或其他高頻且人力密集型營運環境經驗。
• 具 Supply-side Marketing、Worker Marketing、Labor Acquisition、Workforce Retention、Courier Marketing 或 Warehouse Workforce Marketing 經驗。
• 曾透過激勵專案影響前線工作者招募、到職、出勤、活躍、生產力或留任。
• 具 Growth Marketing、CRM、Customer Lifecycle Marketing、Retention Marketing、Loyalty Marketing、Rewards Program、Online Marketing、Performance Marketing、Acquisition Marketing 或 Digital Marketing 經驗，並能提出 Incentive Mechanism、Cohort 策略、量化成果與持續優化的直接證據。
• 曾依不同受眾 Cohort 調整行銷圖像的訊息、資訊層級或 Call to Action。
• 能從商業目標建立 KPI Tree、基準值、監測節奏、歸因限制及優化判準。
• 曾比較不同受眾價值、介入成本、預期增量與資源配置取捨。
• 曾同時管理多方 Stakeholder，或管理具有衝突時程、KPI 或優先順序的多個專案。
招募流程
• 履歷審查 - 電話面談 - 現場或線上完整面談 - 錄取通知
• 實際招募流程將依職位需求調整，亦可能因時程或其他因素變更。
• 面試時間與結果將透過候選人於申請階段提供的電子郵件通知。
注意事項
• 若職缺已招募完成，本職缺可能於公告申請截止日前提前關閉。
• 若候選人在申請過程中提供不實資訊，Coupang 有權撤回錄取通知。
• 符合就業保障資格者，包括依法享有退伍軍人福利或身心障礙就業保障者，將依相關法令獲得相應待遇。

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers are the professional publishing stewards of 2K's portfolio, which currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands — including global powerhouse NBA® 2K, renowned BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization® and XCOM® brands; popular WWE® 2K and WWE® SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, and the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR® 2K.
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don't meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!
What We Need
As Senior Manager, International GTM for EMEA and LATAM, you will be a senior strategic leader responsible for shaping and executing the regional go-to-market approach for NBA 2K across the region. This is not an executional support role. We're looking for someone who can build the regional strategy from the brief up, own paid media planning end to end, and show up as a credible, trusted face of the brand for our most important external partners.
You'll work in close partnership with the global marketing team to ensure our campaigns are globally coherent and locally effective. This role requires someone who thinks strategically, operates with urgency, and builds strong relationships across internal teams and external partners alike.
What You'll Own
Regional GTM Strategy:
Lead the development and delivery of EMEA go-to-market plans that translate the global campaign into regionally effective, culturally resonant marketing. Serve as the regional strategic voice, advocating for local nuance without losing the thread of the global brief.
Paid Media Planning and Execution:
Own the paid media strategy and execution for EMEA from annual planning and channel mix through in-market optimization and performance evaluation. Act as the senior lead in agency relationships, holding partners accountable to both the brief and the business targets.
External Partner Management:
Serve as the primary external-facing representative for NBA 2K across EMEA, building and managing relationships with key agency, media, and marketing partners. Set the tone for how the brand shows up in every external conversation and ensure executional excellence across all partner-led activity.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner closely with Community and Creator, Paid Influencer, and Product Marketing leads to ensure EMEA is fully integrated across all GTM pillars. Champion a more connected way of working across the international team and help establish the workflows that make it stick.
Team Leadership:
Manage, mentor, and develop direct reports across the EMEA team. Own their growth and create a high-functioning team environment that works effectively across time zones.
Performance and Evaluation:
Drive performance conversations throughout the campaign lifecycle, identifying what's working, flagging where adjustments are needed, and leading the regional evaluation process with Commercial, Insights, and Marketing Strategy stakeholders.
What Will Make You a Great Fit
Experienced:
proven experience in marketing with meaningful experience in international or regional strategy, ideally within gaming, entertainment, or consumer brands. You've built plans, not just executed them.
Agency Management:
You've managed agency relationships at a senior level and know how to get the best out of them. You can write a tight brief, hold partners accountable to it, and course-correct when the work isn't landing without burning the relationship.
Paid Media Fluency:
You've owned media plans at a senior level. You understand channel strategy, can hold agencies accountable, and know how to optimize in-market.
Strategic:
Comfortable operating at the campaign level while staying close enough to the details to catch what's slipping. You bring a point of view to every room you're in.

jobs.description: Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Come work at Amazon! The Role: As a RFIC Design Engineer, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive and design innovative product solutions. You will work closely with an internal inter-disciplinary team, and third party suppliers to drive key aspects of product definition, execution and optimization. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment. As a member of the RFIC team, you will be responsible for the architectural definition, design, simulation, layout, and extracted simulation for transmit and receive front-ends from data converters to LNAs and PAs. Strong focus will be on creating power and cost optimized solutions for a given system performance. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities • Collaborate with communications systems, digital design, and chip implementation teams to specify and implement transceivers and RFIC front-end models which will delight future Kuiper customers. • Lead implementation of area/power-efficient RFIC chips with multiple transceiver chains with integrated PLLs from concept to production. • Work closely with packaging/HW/EE/FW teams to ensure seamless system integration providing best value for Kuiper customers. • Collaborate with the digital design team to define analog/digital boundary requirements for circuit calibration, clock generation, and timing. • Explore architectures for mm-wave and RF circuits like VCOs, mixers, phase shifters, LNAs, PAs, LO distribution, frequency multipliers and dividers, and envelope/power detectors, and make detailed presentations on power/area/performance trade-offs. • Design and simulate on-chip inductors, baluns, and power combiners in tools such as EMX or HFSS. • Perform circuit layout, RLC extraction, and run extracted simulation across various corners to make sure designs are robust and can be taken to volume production. • Specify bench and production test plans for your designs.
